text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Don't hesitate to train me hard. I might 
not look it, but I've got a pretty sturdy 
body, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's take our time and 
steadily make our way toward that goal 
without rushing or panicking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
